notes: Eurostat Spain monthly snapshot for 2008-01 through 2025-12. Target is seasonally and calendar adjusted retail sales volume (G47, 2021=100). An external Case Builder enforced the exact 216-month axis with no missing rows, deletion, interpolation, or imputation; clean CSV SHA-256 is a8c01df041db4d835baf83a459ae65194a4d5c9bca157753d56cd6259d106445. Eurostat marked the retail and industrial source snapshots provisional. Results are co-movement and out-of-sample predictive usefulness only.
